reasons.plausibility: A machine-learned potential trained on liquid configurations is a well-studied and credible solution to the known limitations of EAM for complex alloys.
reasons.testability: Comparative thermodynamic integration between EAM and the ML reference to verify improved phase-space overlap and free-energy accuracy is a clear and feasible test.
reasons.usefulness: Adopting a ML potential to better capture high-temperature liquid configurations directly addresses the question’s core problem and would be highly relevant to researchers seeking more accurate free energies.
